basis_note: provisional; doctrine-seeded, n=0 field samples. OpenCode submits on a single Enter; a blind second Enter interrupts reply generation.

recommended.notes: Single Enter submits the prompt. Do NOT send a blind second Enter — it interrupts reply generation. After submit, read the target surface; re-Enter once only if the input bar still shows the un-submitted message.

message_format.notes: Exactly one Enter submits. NEVER send a blind second Enter — it interrupts reply generation. Read the target surface after submit; re-Enter once ONLY if the input bar still shows the un-submitted message.
